headline: FBI case against fake 49ers player adds more alleged victims
summary: The FBI has identified 35 additional women who say they were defrauded by Daejon Love and Taylor Chan, bringing the total number of alleged victims in a case that included Love impersonating as a 49ers player to more than 60.

headline: Stephon Gilmore, '19 NFL DPOY, retires as member of the Patriots
summary: Stephon Gilmore, a two-time All-Pro cornerback and the NFL's 2019 Defensive Player of the Year, signed a one-day contract in New England on Friday to retire as a member of the Patriots,

headline: Vikings to start QB Wentz vs. Bears with Murray still on the mend
summary: Carson Wentz will be the Vikings' starting quarterback Sunday against the Bears while Kyler Murray continues to work his way back after suffering a concussion in the season opener.

headline: With Penix not ready, Rush getting second start for Falcons
summary: The Falcons will start quarterback Cooper Rush for the second straight week, coach Kevin Stefanski said Friday.

headline: Bills are third team ever to start 2-0 while giving up more than 30 points in both games
summary: The Bills have started the season with two wins over two teams that entered the season as favorites to win their divisions.
